incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT 2026-03-15T03:30Z - runtime: high rate of cache_mismatch and unexpected token bleed (metric: cache_mismatch_rate +12x)

incident-bot: observed: small percentage of requests returning fragments from previous, unrelated sessions; logs show `seq_offset_mismatch` and `cache_hit_wrong_seq` entries; elevated p99 on continuous-batching path.

marie: oncall marie here. paging @noah and @ajay and tagging eng-runtime-oncall. can someone confirm whether this is the KV prefix reuse issue?

noah: confirming, repro on staging with mixed-offset traffic. traces show cache hits where stored_seq_offset != request_seq_offset. sample: ```
2026-03-15T03:28:44Z runtime WARN req=zz9 kv_cache: cache_hit_wrong_seq stored_offset=1024 req_offset=1008 shard=7
2026-03-15T03:28:45Z runtime ERROR req=zz9 leak_detected source=kv_shard_7
```

ajay: initial hypothesis: the continuous-batcher optimizer merged pages but didn't normalize offsets before building cache keys; folx, recall we had an invariant that keys must use page-aligned offsets.

sara: I deployed batching/continuous-v2 yesterday (rollout batcher-2026-03-14). It did change how we compute `page_index` for reuse. I'm looking at the PR now.

marie: support-ops, are customers reporting corrupted outputs? any high-severity incidents?

support-ops: we've flagged 9 endpoints with anomalous output tokens. Most are high-concurrency Dedicated tenants. No reports of PII exfil yet, but it's early. Drafting customer comms; will hold until mitigation planned.

noah: mitigation proposal A: disable page-level reuse per shard: set `runtime.kv.reuse_enabled=false` in the config for affected pools. This will force fresh page fetches and stop cross-request reuse. Tradeoff: increased token cost and higher latency.

ajay: mitigation proposal B: set `batcher.continuous_max_inflight=1` for pools to avoid interleaving different offset sequences on same worker. Lower impact than full disable, but may not fully prevent cross-shard reuse race.

marie: can we do staggered canary where we first flip continuous_max_inflight to 1 on two pools, monitor, then disable reuse if still bad?

deploy-bot: recommended commands:
```
rctl patch svc/runtime --env prod --selector pool=fast-pool-a --set batcher.continuous_max_inflight=1
rctl patch svc/runtime --env prod --selector pool=fast-pool-a --set runtime.kv.reuse_enabled=false
```
(rollout is incremental by zone; ~3 minutes per zone)

noah: applying continuous_max_inflight=1 to fast-pool-a now. 
noah: metrics update 2m in: cache_mismatch_rate down 55% on that pool, p99 latency +18ms.

marie: good. apply same change to other fast pooling zones. if mismatch_rate remains >10% after inflight=1 we disable reuse.

sara: code root cause: PR #4138 altered key derivation. gist: function now used raw seq_offset instead of page-normalized offset. snippet: ```python
def make_kv_key(model, prefix_hash, seq_offset):
    # introduced bug: using raw seq_offset, must use page_aligned_offset = seq_offset - (seq_offset % PAGE_SIZE)
    return f"{model}:{prefix_hash}:{seq_offset}"
```
I'll prepare a patch to normalize offset and add an assert on cache hits.

ajay: add a runtime guard: on cache hit, compare stored_metadata.page_base to current request.page_base and reject the hit if mismatch, logging a high-priority metric. That buys us safety even before code fix lands.

noah: ops status: we've rolled inflight=1 to all fast pools. overall systemwide cache_mismatch_rate down ~78%, dedicated-customer errors down to 2 endpoints showing sporadic issues.

support-ops: sending customer note: "We've identified a rare caching bug impacting a subset of high-concurrency workloads. We've applied a temporary mitigation which reduces the optimization that caused the issue and are rolling a correctness fix." Holding for final approval.

marie: eng-runtime-oncall take ownership for hotfix and release. Priority: fix key derivation + add sanity metadata check + unit + integration tests. Then do a canary re-enable behind `kv_reuse_safe_mode=true`.

eng-runtime-oncall: plan: 1) hotfix branch with normalization + metadata check -> ship v2026.03.15-hf1 within 2.5 hours, 2) post-deploy canary at 5% for 20 minutes, watch cache_mismatch_rate and invalid-seq logs, 3) if green, enable reuse behind safety flag and ramp.

marie: also create incident ticket and assign postmortem to eng-runtime, include regression window and customer list. good catch.

ajay: saved a minimal repro and put it in the ticket along with deterministic seed and curl-based workload script. useful for CI test addition.

noah: operational note for next oncall: watch metrics `cache_mismatch_rate`, `cache_hit_wrong_seq`, customer output complaints. If regression reappears escalate immediately.

support-ops: customer message sent to impacted tenants. receiving a few replies, triaging.

marie: state: mitigated -> monitoring. we'll reconvene after hotfix. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
__notes: synthetic slack incident thread about KV cache reuse correctness and live mitigations
